a.lede: JustWatch, the popular streaming search guide used by 50 million people, is launching its own streaming service, offering free, ad-supported movies and shows alongside a $3.99-per-month ad-free tier and movie rentals.
a.title: Streaming guide JustWatch becomes a streamer itself

b.lede: Remember Popcorn Time, the app that served as an easy-to-use front end for streaming torrents of movies and TV shows? b.title: Abandoned Popcorn Time apps had to be disabled to prevent a zombie army
